title: Calculation Note: Closing and Funding Late-Funding Refund Amount
content:
**Formal clause.** A late-funding refund returns the prepaid interest a funded Closing and Funding closing collected for days on which its loan was not yet funded, where the disbursement date falls on or after the first day and on or before the last day of the prepaid interest charge collected at closing. For a late-funding refund, the charge collected at closing is the closing's prepaid interest charge booked on the signing date. The late days are the days from the estimated funding date up to the day before the disbursement date. In the standard refund, each late day is refunded at the same daily amount the charge collected at closing used. The late-funding refund is the refunded days times that daily amount, rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities and where they are read

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| charge collected at closing (first day, last day, daily amount) | the closing's prepaid interest charge entry booked on the signing date |
| estimated funding date, disbursement date | the closing record |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

The charge collected at closing was booked on the signing date and covers the 24th through the 30th of a 30-day month at a daily amount of 52.05. The estimated funding date is the 24th and the disbursement date is the 27th.

1. The disbursement date, the 27th, falls within the charge (24th to 30th), so the refund is computed on that charge.
2. Late days: the 24th, 25th and 26th, which is 3 days, each refunded in the standard refund.
3. Refund: 3 times 52.05, which is 156.15.

| Variation (hypothetical) | Late days | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| disbursement date the 25th | 1 | 52.05 |
| disbursement date the 24th (the estimated funding date itself) | 0 | 0.00 |
| disbursement date the 2nd of the next month, outside the charge | the condition for a late-funding refund on that charge is not met | |
